items.title: STRAND: a comprehensive subcellular-resolved spatial transcriptome RNA architecture and navigation database
items.title_zh: STRAND：综合性亚细胞解析空间转录组 RNA 架构和导航数据库
items.summary_zh: 摘要 亚细胞 RNA 定位是控制细胞极化、局部翻译和功能区划的关键调控层。高分辨率空间转录组学的最新进展为以单分子分辨率解​​析这些细胞内结构提供了前所未有的机会。然而，相关数据集分散在不同的研究和存储库中，处理程序和标准差异很大，严重限制了它们的交叉研究重用。为了弥补这一差距，我们推出了 STRAND（亚细胞解析空间转录组 RNA 架构和导航数据库），这是一个精心策划的数据资源和分析平台，用于自动收获、质量控制和解释亚细胞空间转录组数据。通过代理辅助管理流程，STRAND 已从六个主要平台收集了 35 个亚细胞分辨率数据集，涵盖人类和小鼠的 17 种组织类型，总计约 49 亿个转录坐标。在此标准化数据资源的基础上，STRAND 提供了涵盖细胞分割评估、细胞类型注释、RNA 定位/共定位模式注释和亚细胞区室推断的分析工作流程。两个案例研究表明 STRAND 成功识别了培养细胞系中已建立的

extra.description: Abstract Subcellular RNA localization serves as a critical regulatory layer governing cellular polarization, local translation, and functional compartmentalization. Recent advances in high-resolution spatial transcriptomics have provided unprecedented opportunities to resolve these intracellular architectures at single-molecule resolution. However, relevant datasets are dispersed across studies and repositories, vary substantially in processing procedures and standards, severely limiting their cross-study reuse. To bridge this gap, we present STRAND (Subcellular-Resolved Spatial Transcriptome RNA Architecture and Navigation Database), a curated data resource and analysis platform for the automated harvesting, quality control, and interpretation of subcellular spatial transcriptomics data. Through an agent-assisted curation pipeline, STRAND has assembled 35 subcellular-resolution datasets from six major platforms, covering 17 tissue types in human and mouse and totalling ∼4.9 billion transcript coordinates. Building upon this standardized data resource, STRAND provides an analytical workflow spanning cell segmentation evaluation, cell-type annotation, RNA localization/colocalization pattern annotation, and subcellular compartment inference. Two case studies demonstrate that STRAND successfully identifies established RNA localization patterns in cultured cell lines and detects drug-induced RNA relocalization in cardiomyocytes. STRAND is openly available at https://strand.phasep.pro.

items.title: Cd47 deficiency in mouse brain under excitotoxic stress
items.title_zh: 兴奋性毒性应激下小鼠大脑中 CD47 缺乏
items.summary_zh: CD47 是一种具有明确的免疫和神经发育作用的跨膜蛋白，最近被鉴定为人类、非人类灵长类动物和小鼠中丰富的突触前蛋白。为了研究 Cd47 如何影响神经元应激和损伤，我们对暴露于惊厥（KA25；25 mg/kg）或亚惊厥（KA3；3 mg/kg）剂量红藻氨酸（KA）的野生型（WT）和 Cd47 敲除（KO）小鼠的海马进行单核 RNA 测序。将细胞类型注释与加权基因共表达网络分析 (WGCNA) 相结合，揭示了不同的神经元和神经胶质基因模块，其共表达结构因基因型和 KA 暴露而异。值得注意的是，某些模块仅在 Cd47 缺陷细胞中显示出与 KA 相关的共表达结构变化。这些模块的富集分析突出了翻译、生物能和突触基因集。使用 Wasserstein 距离比较转录组范围的分布表明，在所有 15 个成对比较中，载体处理的 KO 细胞与暴露于 KA3 的 WT 细胞最相似。这些发现表明，Cd47 的丢失使海

extra.description: CD47, a transmembrane protein with well-established immune and neurodevelopmental roles, was recently identified as an abundant presynaptic protein in humans, non-human primates, and mice. To investigate how Cd47 influences neuronal stress and injury, we performed single-nucleus RNA sequencing of hippocampi from wild-type (WT) and Cd47 knockout (KO) mice exposed to kainic acid (KA) at convulsive (KA25; 25 mg/kg) or subconvulsive (KA3; 3 mg/kg) doses. Integrating cell-type annotations with Weighted Gene Co-expression Network Analysis (WGCNA) revealed distinct neuronal and glial gene modules whose co-expression structure differed by genotype and by KA exposure. Notably, certain modules showed KA-associated changes in co-expression structure only in Cd47 -deficient cells. Enrichment analyses of these modules highlighted translational, bioenergetic, and synaptic gene sets. Comparing transcriptome-wide distributions using Wasserstein distance demonstrated that vehicle-treated KO cells most closely resembled WT cells exposed to KA3, of all fifteen pairwise comparisons. These findings suggest that Cd47 loss shifts the hippocampal transcriptome toward a state resembling mild excitotoxic stress, implicating Cd47 as a candidate regulator of neuronal stress adaptation and providing a hypothesis for testing that role.

items.title: OSCAR: an omics atlas of paired single-cell ATAC-seq and RNA-seq for decoding cell-specific gene regulation
items.title_zh: OSCAR：配对单细胞 ATAC-seq 和 RNA-seq 的组学图谱，用于解码细胞特异性基因调控
items.summary_zh: 摘要 成对的单细胞染色质可及性和转录组图谱为剖析不同生物过程和人类疾病背后的细胞特异性调控程序提供了强大的框架。用于转座酶可及的染色质测序 (scATAC-seq) 和单细胞 RNA 测序 (scRNA-seq) 的配对单细胞测定数据的快速积累导致迫切需要全面整合这些数据，以说明单细胞分辨率的监管格局。为了满足这一需求，我们开发了 OSCAR（配对单细胞 ATAC 和 RNA-seq 的组学图集，https://bio.liclab.net/OSCAR/）来整理大规模配对 scATAC-seq 和 scRNA-seq 数据，并提供全面的监管注释和分析。当前版本的 OSCAR 对 30 种组织类型的 1136 个样本中的 7749 898 个人类细胞进行了编目。重要的是，OSCAR集成了成对的scATAC-seq和scRNA-seq图谱，用于联合细胞聚类和峰-基因连锁识别，并为标记峰和标记基

extra.description: Abstract Paired single-cell chromatin accessibility and transcriptome profiles provide a powerful framework for dissecting cell-specific regulatory programs underlying diverse biological processes and human diseases. The rapid accumulation of paired single-cell assay for transposase-accessible chromatin sequencing (scATAC-seq) and single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) data has led to an urgent need to comprehensively integrate these data to illustrate the regulatory landscape at single-cell resolution. To address this need, we developed OSCAR (an Omics atlas of paired Single-Cell ATAC and RNA-seq, https://bio.liclab.net/OSCAR/) to curate large-scale paired scATAC-seq and scRNA-seq data and to provide comprehensive regulatory annotations and analyses. The current version of OSCAR catalogs 7749 898 human cells from 1136 samples across 30 tissue types. Importantly, OSCAR integrates paired scATAC-seq and scRNA-seq profiles for joint cell clustering and peak-to-gene linkage identification, and provides detailed (epi)genetic annotations for marker peaks and regulatory elements of marker genes, including super-enhancers, enhancers, enhancer RNAs (eRNAs), common and risk single nucleotide polymorphisms, expression quantitative trait loci, transcription factor binding sites, transcription factor/transcription co-factor binding peaks, Clustered Regularly Interspaced Short Palindromic Repeats (CRISPR)/Cas9 target sites, DNase I hypersensitivity sites, chromatin accessibility regions, DNA methylation sites, chromatin interaction regions, and topologically associating domains. Furthermore, OSCAR provides three online analysis tools, including cell type enrichment analysis, sequence-based peak regulatory analysis, and peak-to-gene linkage analysis. Hence, OSCAR is a useful platform to query, browse, analyze, and visualize cell-specific regulatory programs across diverse human tissues and diseases.

items.title: An extensible deep learning framework for multi-type chromatin interaction prediction through hierarchical adaptation strategies
items.title_zh: 一个通过分层适应策略进行多类型染色质相互作用预测的可扩展深度学习框架
items.summary_zh: 三维染色质相互作用在基因调控中起重要作用，然而多种相互作用类型的计算预测在很大程度上仍依赖于专门的单任务模型。在这里，我们提出UniLoopNet，一个多任务深度学习框架，可从DNA序列预测多种类型的染色质相互作用，包括增强子-启动子相互作用、增强子-增强子相互作用、CTCF介导的环和条纹相关相互作用。UniLoopNet采用共享编码器-解码器架构和分层适应策略，基于任务语义相似性整合多任务、迁移和持续学习。跨多个细胞系的全面基准测试表明，UniLoopNet优于现有的专门和多任务方法，大多数任务的AUROC超过0.90。在严格评估设置下，包括染色体匹配、距离匹配、现实不平衡和位点不相交测试，AUROC范围为0.8934至0.9366。在现实的1:5类别不平衡设置中，增强子-启动子和增强子-增强子相互作用预测的AUPRC分别为0.7956和0.6935。跨细胞系迁移实验进一步表明，将Uni

extra.description: Three-dimensional chromatin interactions play essential roles in gene regulation, yet computational prediction of diverse interaction types remains largely dependent on specialized, single-task models. Here, we present UniLoopNet, a multi-task deep learning framework that predicts multiple types of chromatin interactions including enhancer–promoter interactions, enhancer–enhancer interactions, CTCF-mediated loops, and stripe-associated interactions from DNA sequences. UniLoopNet employs a shared encoder–decoder architecture with hierarchical adaptation strategies, integrating multi-task, transfer, and continual learning based on task semantic similarity. Comprehensive benchmarking across multiple cell lines demonstrates that UniLoopNet outperforms existing specialized and multi-task approaches, with AUROCs exceeding 0.90 in most tasks. Under stringent evaluation settings, including chromosome-matched, distance-matched, realistic imbalanced, and locus-disjoint tests, AUROCs range from 0.8934 to 0.9366. In the realistic 1:5 class-imbalance setting, the AUPRCs for enhancer–promoter and enhancer–enhancer interaction prediction are 0.7956 and 0.6935, respectively. Cross-cell-line transfer experiments further show that applying UniLoopNet to another cell line requires adaptation by supervised fine-tuning on target-cell-line data, after which performance is comparable to that of within-cell-line training. Notably, the framework exhibits data efficiency in experiments with substantially reduced training data. Interpretability analyses reveal that the learned sequence features are associated with known transcription factor binding sites and uncover differential regulatory effects of disease-associated variants. UniLoopNet provides a versatile and data-efficient framework for sequence-based prediction and interpretation of diverse 3D genome interactions, complementing existing sequence-to-map approaches while improving the understanding of sequence-encoded regulatory potential.

items.title: HGVD: Human Genetic Variation Database update 2026 with sequencing of 4344 genetically diverse Japanese individuals
items.title_zh: HGVD：人类遗传变异数据库 2026 年更新，对 4344 名遗传多样性日本个体进行测序
items.summary_zh: 摘要：人口规模的基因组资源仍然偏向于欧洲血统，限制了代表性不足的人群中的变异解释。在这里，我们扩展了人类遗传变异数据库 (HGVD)，这是一个于 2013 年推出的免费日本等位基因频率资源。HGVD v3.1 整合了通过主成分分析 (PCA) 选择的 3135 个日本个体的 1209 个外显子组和全基因组测序 (WGS) 数据，以跨越遗传多样性，提供 4344 个个体、3248 个基因分型个体和表达数量性状位点的聚合变异统计数据(eQTL) 来自 300 个人。对于研究和临床使用，HGVD 为 GRCh37/hg19、GRCh38/hg38 和 T2T-CHM13 提供协调的基于 JBrowse 的浏览器。非 GRCh37 变体轨道是由 liftOver 从 GRCh37 调用集生成的。变异频率、样本计数和覆盖范围可跨程序集使用，而 eQTL 注释目前仅在 hg19 上可用。提供了可下载的

extra.description: Abstract Population-scale genome resources remain biased toward European ancestry, limiting variant interpretation in underrepresented populations. Here, we expanded the Human Genetic Variation Database (HGVD), a free Japanese allele-frequency resource launched in 2013. HGVD v3.1 integrates 1209 exomes with whole-genome sequencing (WGS) data from 3135 Japanese individuals selected by principal component analysis (PCA) to span genetic diversity, providing aggregate variant statistics for 4344 individuals, 3248 genotyped individuals, and expression quantitative trait loci (eQTL) from 300 individuals. For research and clinical use, HGVD provides coordinated JBrowse-based browsers for GRCh37/hg19, GRCh38/hg38, and T2T-CHM13. The non-GRCh37 variant tracks were generated by liftOver from the GRCh37 call set. Variant frequencies, sample counts, and coverage are available across assemblies, whereas eQTL annotations are currently available only on hg19. A downloadable, graph-genome–ready structural-variant release is provided, and the new pathSTR portal reports population-level distributions for 68 medically relevant tandem-repeat loci, derived by applying STRdust to long-read Oxford Nanopore data from 1019 individuals of the 1000 Genomes Project remapped to T2T-CHM13. HGVD v3.1 supports population-matched interpretation of rare pathogenic and pharmacogenomic variants, comparison of repeat-expansion alleles with long-read reference distributions, and structural-variant-aware reference construction, supporting precision medicine for Japan and East Asian populations. HGVD is available at https://www.hgvd.genome.med.kyoto-u.ac.jp/.

items.title: Categorization and analysis of 16 computational methods for estimating cell potency from single-cell RNA-seq data.
items.title_zh: 用于从单细胞 RNA-seq 数据估计细胞效力的 16 种计算方法的分类和分析。
items.summary_zh: 从静态单细胞 RNA 测序 (scRNA-seq) 数据推断隐藏的细胞动力学仍然是一个严峻的挑战。除了伪时间轨迹和 RNA 速度之外，细胞效能通过从基因表达水平估计细胞分化潜力提供了另一种视角。我们回顾了 16 种在不同的、有时是对比的假设下定义细胞效力的计算方法。根据他们如何将基因表达总结为效力测量，我们将它们分为基于平均值的方法、基于熵的方法和基于知识的方法。我们使用一套统一的数学符号，详细介绍了它们的方法，解释了类别内部和类别之间的关键相似点和差异，并总结了使用复杂性。鉴于方法的多样性，单细胞分辨率的社区基准数据集和仔细的敏感性分析对于从多个角度评估方法并可能提高稳定性和普遍性至关重要。本文为方法基准测试提供了基础，并强调了比较推断伪时间轨迹、RNA 速度和细胞效力的方法所面临的挑战。

extra.description: Inferring hidden cellular dynamics from static single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) data remains a critical challenge. Beyond pseudotime trajectories and RNA velocities, cell potency provides another perspective by estimating cellular differentiation potential from gene expression levels. We review 16 computational methods that define cell potency under different, sometimes contrasting, assumptions. On the basis of how they summarize gene expression into a potency measure, we categorize them into average-based, entropy-based, and knowledge-based methods. Using a unified set of mathematical notations, we detail their methodologies, explain key similarities and differences within and between categories, and summarize usage complexities. Given the diversity of methods, community benchmark datasets at single-cell resolution and careful sensitivity analyses are crucial for evaluating methods from multiple angles and potentially improving stability and generalizability. This article provides a basis for method benchmarking and highlights the remaining challenge of comparing methods for inferring pseudotime trajectories, RNA velocities, and cell potency.

items.title: DiseaseCIO: a multi-omics atlas for characterizing clinical intervention outcomes across diverse diseases
items.title_zh: 疾病CIO：用于描述不同疾病的临床干预结果的多组学图集
items.summary_zh: 摘要 患者临床干预结果的异质性是精准医疗的主要障碍。多维高通量组学的整合有助于揭示临床干预差异的分子基础，并为结果预测、预后分层、调控模式和耐药机制提供见解。我们提出了DiseaseCIO（疾病临床干预结果，http://db.edbc.org/DiseaseCIO/），这是一个将微生物组、转录组和表观基因组数据与人类疾病干预结果整合在一起的数据库。它旨在描述与个体患者水平的疾病干预结果相关的分子景观。 《DiseaseCIO》包含来自 94 个疾病状态的 42 798 个治疗前样本，涵盖 510 种治疗方案，涉及 377 种药物和非药物干预措施。这些样本包括从八个采样地点采集的四种类型的标本。使用定制的 iMOD 工作流程进行多组学数据处理，我们生成了 20 类分子特征，并确定了超过 184 万个候选特征-结果关联。疾病CIO还提供交互式工具，用于多维特征的差异分析、预后评估、跨组学相关

extra.description: Abstract Heterogeneity in clinical intervention outcomes across patients is a major barrier to precision medicine. The integration of multidimensional high-throughput omics can help reveal the molecular basis of differences in clinical interventions and provide insights into outcome prediction, prognostic stratification, regulatory patterns, and resistance mechanisms. We present DiseaseCIO (Disease Clinical Intervention Outcomes, http://db.edbc.org/DiseaseCIO/), a database that integrates microbiome, transcriptome, and epigenome data with human disease intervention outcomes. It is designed to characterize the molecular landscape associated with disease intervention outcomes at the individual patient level. DiseaseCIO encompasses 42 798 pretreatment samples from 94 disease states, covering 510 treatment regimens involving 377 pharmacological and non-pharmacological interventions. These samples comprise four types of specimens collected from eight sampling locations. Using the customized iMOD workflow for multi-omics data processing, we generated 20 categories of molecular features and identified >1.84 million candidate feature–outcome associations. DiseaseCIO also provides interactive tools for differential analysis, prognostic evaluation, cross-omics correlation analysis, and cross-cohort integrative analysis of multidimensional features as well as enrichment analysis and signature construction for user-submitted feature sets. DiseaseCIO provides a molecular-level resource for exploring intervention outcome heterogeneity across diseases and identifying candidate multi-omics biomarkers associated with treatment response and prognosis.

items.title: XYcellAtlas: a cell-type- and spatial-resolved pan-cancer atlas of sex-biased and Y chromosome loss-associated molecular signatures
items.title_zh: XYcellAtlas：性别偏见和 Y 染色体丢失相关分子特征的细胞类型和空间解析泛癌图谱
items.summary_zh: 摘要 性别是癌症易感性、临床预后和治疗反应的关键决定因素。性染色体畸变，特别是男性恶性肿瘤中 Y 染色体 (LOY) 的体细胞缺失，对转录调控、肿瘤免疫微环境重塑和恶性进展产生深远影响，凸显了对单细胞和空间组学概况的全面整合的迫切需求，以剖析人类癌症中的性别偏见和 LOY 景观。在这里，我们开发了 XYcellAtlas (http://www.xycellatlas.top/)，这是一个综合数据库，用于以单细胞转录组、表观基因组和空间转录组分辨率对人体组织中的性别差异和 LOY 特征进行整合和多维可视化。该资源汇总了 6764 名患者样本的数据，涵盖 18 种癌症类型、8 种癌前病变和 21 种组织起源，涵盖超过 2580 万个单细胞和 100 万个空间转录组点。利用在正常组织数据集上训练的随机森林分类器，XYcellAtlas 可以量化跨细胞类型的细胞类型特异性 LOY 频率。此外，它

extra.description: Abstract Sex is a critical determinant of cancer susceptibility, clinical prognosis, and therapeutic response. Sex chromosome aberrations, particularly somatic loss of the Y chromosome (LOY) in male malignancies, exert profound impacts on transcriptional regulation, tumor immune microenvironment remodeling, and malignant progression, highlighting an urgent demand for comprehensive integration of single–cell and spatial omics profiles dissecting sex-biased and LOY landscapes across human cancers. Here, we developed XYcellAtlas (http://www.xycellatlas.top/), an integrative database for integration and multidimensional visualization of sex disparities and LOY features across human tissues at single-cell transcriptomic, epigenomic, and spatial-transcriptomic resolutions. This resource aggregates data from 6764 patient samples covering 18 cancer types, eight precancerous lesions, and 21 tissue origins, encompassing over 25.8 million single cells and one million spatial-transcriptomic spots. Leveraging random forest classifiers trained on normal tissue datasets, XYcellAtlas quantifies cell-type-specific LOY frequencies across cell types. Furthermore, it systematically catalogs sex-biased and LOY-associated molecular alterations, including differentially expressed genes, chromatin peaks, core transcription factors, as well as their functional annotations and dysregulatory signatures within malignant cells and the tumor microenvironment. In summary, XYcellAtlas provides a unified, all-in-one analytical platform enabling researchers to query, inspect, quantify, and visualize sex-associated and LOY-derived multi-omics features underlying tumor evolutionary processes.

items.title: Innate sensor responses set a supra-unitary threshold for viral replication.
items.title_zh: 先天传感器反应为病毒复制设定了超单一阈值。
items.summary_zh: 细胞通过触发快速、敏感的先天免疫反应来抵抗病毒感染，该反应由细胞质病毒传感器蛋白 (CyVSP)、视黄酸诱导基因 I (RIG-I)、黑色素瘤分化相关蛋白 5 (MDA-5) 和蛋白激酶 R (PKR) 启动。我们的单细胞分析表明，病毒复制需要超单一的病毒基因组输入，明显多于一个，我们将其定义为复制的病毒体输入阈值（VITREP）。该阈值根据病毒和细胞类型而变化，与病毒蛋白质合成无关。通过数学模型和实验测试，我们发现超单一病毒基因组数量激活 CyVSP 的负反馈调节因子 (NFR)，包括死亡相关蛋白激酶 1 (DAPK1)、Rio 激酶 3 (RIOK3) 和蛋白磷酸酶 2 调节亚基 α (PPP2R2A)，抑制先天免疫反应并允许复制。我们验证了模型的关键预测，即下调 NFR 会减少复制，而上调 NFR 或共感染细胞会促进复制。总之，这些发现揭示了控制病毒感染性和组织向性的基本机制。

extra.description: Cells resist viral infection by triggering rapid and sensitive innate immune responses, initiated by cytoplasmic viral sensor proteins (CyVSP), retinoic acid-inducible gene I (RIG-I), melanoma differentiation-associated protein 5 (MDA-5), and protein kinase R (PKR). Our single-cell analysis reveals that viral replication requires a supra-unitary viral genome input, significantly more than one, which we define as the virion input threshold for replication (VITREP). This threshold varies depending on viruses and cell types, independently of viral protein synthesis. Through mathematical modeling and experimental testing, we uncover that supra-unitary viral genome quantities activate negative feedback regulators (NFR) of CyVSP, including death-associated protein kinase 1 (DAPK1), Rio kinase 3 (RIOK3), and protein phosphatase 2 regulatory subunit alpha (PPP2R2A), that suppress innate immune responses and allow replication. We validate key predictions of our model, namely that downregulating NFR reduces replication, whereas upregulating NFR or coinfecting cells promotes replication. Together, these findings reveal a fundamental mechanism governing viral infectivity and tissue tropism.

items.title: Toward planetary microbial systems biology.
items.title_zh: 走向行星微生物系统生物学。
items.summary_zh: 微生物是地球生物圈的基础，维持生命、塑造生物地球化学循环并维持生态系统稳定。在科学和地缘政治碎片化的时代，我们主张建立“行星微生物系统生物学”（PMSB）框架，以揭示跨物质、空间和时间尺度以及与潜在的自然和人为驱动因素相关的地球相互关联的微生物系统的机制和组织原则。 PMSB 结合了分子和细胞技术、多组学数据、人工智能 (AI) 以及跨生态系统的综合跨学科研究。通过联合开放数据并结合现场观测、实验和建模，PMSB 能够预测性地了解整个行星尺度的微生物组动态，从而填补了我们对生命和地球系统共同进化的理解中的一个关键知识空白。

extra.description: Microorganisms underpin Earth's biosphere, sustaining life, shaping biogeochemical cycles, and maintaining ecosystem stability. In an era of scientific and geopolitical fragmentation, we advocate for a "planetary microbial systems biology" (PMSB) framework to uncover the mechanisms and organizational principles governing Earth's interconnected microbial systems across scales of matter, space, and time and in relation to underlying natural and anthropogenic drivers. PMSB combines molecular and cellular technologies, multi-omics data, artificial intelligence (AI), and integrated transdisciplinary research across ecosystems. By federating open data and combining field observations, experimentation, and modeling, PMSB enables predictive understanding of microbiome dynamics across planetary scales, thus filling a critical knowledge gap in our understanding of the co-evolution of life and the Earth-system.

items.title: Spatial coordination in the codevelopment of the human urogenital system during organogenesis.
items.title_zh: 器官发生过程中人类泌尿生殖系统共同发育的空间协调。
items.summary_zh: 人类泌尿生殖系统起源于共同的胚胎域，但指导其时空协调的机制仍未得到充分研究。在这里，我们将高分辨率空间转录组学与单细胞多组学相结合，对卡内基 15 至 23 期的人类胚胎进行分析，捕获泌尿生殖系统的共同发育动态。我们揭示了中肾和肾上腺原基衍生的信号，这些信号促进性腺规范并能够在体外有效生成类似于早期性腺谱系的细胞。我们还通过连接中肾的睾丸网或卵巢发现了性腺支持细胞可能的中肾起源。最后，我们描绘了三个转录上不同的类固醇生成谱系，它们在胆固醇来源、皮质醇合成和性激素产生方面不同，共同协调性别分化。这些发现加深了我们对泌尿生殖系统组装的理解，并指导多器官协调发育的探索。

extra.description: The human urogenital system originates from a common embryonic domain, yet the mechanisms guiding its spatiotemporal coordination remain understudied. Here, we combined high-resolution spatial transcriptomics with single-cell multiomics to profile human embryos from Carnegie stages 15 to 23, capturing the codevelopmental dynamics of the urogenital system. We revealed mesonephros- and adrenal primordium-derived signals that promote gonadal specification and enable efficient in vitro generation of cells resembling early gonadal lineages. We also uncovered a possible mesonephric origin of gonadal supporting cells through rete testis or ovarii linking the mesonephros. Finally, we delineate three transcriptionally distinct steroidogenic lineages differing in cholesterol sourcing, cortisol synthesis, and sex hormone production that together orchestrate sex differentiation. These findings deepen our understanding of urogenital system assembly and guide the exploration of coordinated multiorgan development.

extra.description: Abstract Genome-wide association studies (GWAS) have identified numerous loci associated with complex diseases and traits, yet the functional interpretation of non-coding risk variants remains challenging. Sequence-to-function models like AlphaGenome provide large-scale multi-modal predictions of variant effects, but their predictions lack direct experimental support. In contrast, empirical resources such as molecular quantitative trait loci (QTLs) and massively parallel reporter assays (MPRAs) offer population-based or experimental support for variant function, but suffer from limited genomic coverage. Here, we present VarNexus (https://biomed.imu.edu.cn/varnexus), an integrative resource for connecting disease-associated variants with predicted, population-based, and experimental evidence. VarNexus currently contains 230 404 fine-mapped candidate variants across 1891 disease-related phenotypes from UK Biobank and FinnGen. It integrates precomputed AlphaGenome predictions across 11 regulatory output types with bulk and single-cell xQTLs, MPRA measurements, and GWAS-eQTL colocalization results. VarNexus enables cross-linked searches by variant, phenotype, and gene, together with on-demand AlphaGenome prediction, multi-omics genome-browser visualization, and regulatory network exploration. By combining sequence-based predictions with population-based and experimental evidence, VarNexus provides a framework for prioritizing candidate regulatory mechanisms supported by multiple evidence layers.

extra.description: Abstract The updated CellMarker 3.0 resource (http://bio-bigdata.hrbmu.edu.cn/CellMarker) offers a comprehensive resource, integrating experimentally validated and robustly algorithm-predicted marker genes for diverse cell types across human and mouse tissues. In addition, web tools for analyzing single-cell RNA-seq (scRNA-seq) and spatial transcriptomics (ST) data are described. CellMarker 3.0 was updated with more data and new features, including (i) appending 274 tissues, 1877 cell types, 64 040 markers, and 1 245 923 tissue–cell type–marker entries over the previous version. The current release contains 930 tissues, 4455 cell types, and 90 955 cell markers, resulting in a total of 1 329 284 tissue–cell type–marker entries. (ii) Expanding the resource to include computationally predicted cell-type markers derived from six algorithms, namely Spapros, Seurat::FindAllMarkers, SEMITONES, Cepo, CelliD, and COSG. (iii) New marker information was incorporated from 168 sequencing technologies, such as CEL-Seq2 and SNARE-seq. (iv) Covering 35 types of cell markers, including protein–coding genes, rRNAs, and pseudogenes. (v) The cell tool module was comprehensively restructured and upgraded, with the original six scRNA-seq analysis modules systematically optimized and two new spatial transcriptomics modules, Spatial Expression, and Spatial Chat, added. CellMarker 3.0 is a valuable resource that integrates cell identity identification, single-cell transcriptomics, and spatial transcriptomics analysis.

items.title: Cell3D: a comprehensive database for interactive 3D visualization and crosstalk analysis of single-cell and spatial omics

items.summary_zh: 摘要 单细胞和空间转录组学产生大规模、高维数据集。然而，跨特征整合探索受到限制，因为大多数当前平台支持单一数据类型，且缺乏用于多特征分析的交互式可视化。为满足这一未满足的需求，我们开发了Cell3D，一个可访问且多功能的交互式平台，旨在推进整合性多层次特征分析。Cell3D整理了898个公开可用数据集，包括397个单细胞和501个空间转录组数据集，涵盖来自11个物种的105种疾病、756种细胞类型和83个器官/组织中的2,924,646个单细胞和空间点。该数据库整合了12个主流功能注释系统，为在空间和细胞维度上剖析分子特征提供了全面图景。用户可以在多个层面探索数据，从基因表达和细胞簇到通路活性和临床表型。Cell3D提供了一套用户友好的功能，包括可定制的2D/3D交互式可视化，用于动态多层次特征投影；具有自动识别功能的灵活数据整合；定量串扰分析；以及聚焦微环境的整合分析，支持疾病研究和生物

extra.description: Abstract Single-cell and spatial transcriptomics yield large-scale, high-dimensional datasets. However, cross-feature integrative exploration is constrained, since most current platforms support a single data type and lack interactive visualization for multi-feature analysis. To address this unmet need, we developed Cell3D, an accessible and versatile interactive platform designed to advance integrative multi-level feature analysis. Cell3D curates 898 publicly available datasets, comprising 397 single-cell and 501 spatial transcriptomic datasets, encompassing 2 924 646 single cells and spatial spots across 105 diseases, 756 cell types, and 83 organs/tissues from 11 species. The database integrates twelve mainstream functional annotation systems, providing a comprehensive landscape for dissecting molecular features across spatial and cellular dimensions. Users can explore data at multiple levels, from gene expression and cell clusters to pathway activities and clinical phenotypes. Cell3D offers a suite of user-friendly functionalities, including customizable 2D/3D interactive visualization for dynamic multi-level feature projection, flexible data integration with automatic recognition, quantitative crosstalk analysis, and microenvironment-focused integrative analysis supporting disease research and biomarker discovery. Collectively, Cell3D enables exploration of tissue microenvironments at both cellular and spatial resolutions, bridging molecular perturbations and tissue architecture in health and disease. The database is freely accessible at https://bio-bigdata.hrbmu.edu.cn/Cell3D.

items.summary_zh: 摘要 空间微环境和细胞功能状态由时空动态基因调控网络（GRN）调控，因此解析它们对于理解疾病发病机制和正常组织程序至关重要。尽管多个空间转录组数据库快速发展，但大多数缺乏对细胞内 GRN 及其空间耦合模式的系统整合。在此，我们提出 SpatialRegNet（https://bio-bigdata.hrbmu.edu.cn/SpatialRegNet/），一个综合数据库，整理了来自 152 个人类和小鼠空间转录组数据集的 1322 张组织切片，覆盖 68 种组织类型和 93 种不同疾病或疾病亚型，包含 3,744,216 个空间 spot。该数据库量化了 6733 个转录因子（TF）介导的 regulon 网络的 spot 级活性，这些网络共包含超过 1270 万个 TF–靶基因对，并归档了 802,935 个在不同空间 niche/细胞类型中高度活跃的 regulon 网络。Spatia

extra.description: Abstract The spatial microenvironment and cellular functional states are governed by spatiotemporally dynamic gene regulatory networks (GRNs), making their dissection essential for understanding disease pathogenesis and normal tissue programs. Despite the rapid development of multiple spatial transcriptomics databases, most lack systematic integration of intracellular GRNs and their spatial coupling patterns. Here, we present SpatialRegNet (https://bio-bigdata.hrbmu.edu.cn/SpatialRegNet/), a comprehensive database curating 1322 tissue slices derived from 152 human and mouse spatial transcriptomic datasets that span 68 tissue types and 93 distinct diseases or disease subtypes, encompassing 3 744 216 spatial spots. The database quantifies spot-level activity for 6733 transcription factor (TF)-mediated regulon networks, which collectively contain over 12.7 million TF–target gene pairs, and archives 802 935 regulon networks that are highly active in distinct spatial niches/cell types. SpatialRegNet embeds a suite of interactive online tools for analyzing regulon networks in spatial contexts, enabling users to interrogate the correlations between regulon network activity and cellular identities, map spatial regulatory heterogeneity and specificity, track dynamic regulon network activity across cell differentiation trajectories, reconstruct intercellular communication signaling cascades, and generate three-dimensional visualizations of regulon network activity. Collectively, SpatialRegNet constitutes a valuable public resource to advance mechanistic investigations of physiological tissue function, disease etiology, and biomarker discovery in spatially resolved GRNs.

items.summary_zh: 摘要 背景 基因组剂量增加可改变细胞和调控状态，但脊椎动物胚胎在全基因组剂量增加后如何维持协调的发育进程仍不清楚。结果 在此，我们研究了大黄鱼（Larimichthys crocea）冷休克诱导三倍体胚胎发生过程中的发育、转录组和DNA甲基化模式。三倍体胚胎的DNA含量约高1.51倍，并在与二倍体对照相当的时间达到主要发育阶段。在八个阶段中，发育阶段而非倍性主导了全局RNA-seq变异，表明相对转录组组成广泛保守。逐阶段比较识别出局部转录差异主要集中于囊胚期和心跳期。阶段×倍性交互分析揭示了涉及RNA加工、胚胎模式形成、细胞外基质组织和收缩发育的独特发育表达轨迹。三个阶段的全基因组亚硫酸氢盐测序揭示了广泛且双向的区域甲基化差异。相对于可分析的基因组窗口，差异甲基化区域在基因组背景中显示非随机富集，尤其在CpG岛和启动子中富集强烈。然而，启动子、基因体、外显子和内含子背景中的甲基化-表达相关

extra.description: Abstract Background Increased genome dosage can alter cellular and regulatory states, yet how vertebrate embryos maintain coordinated developmental progression following a whole-genome dosage increase remains unclear. Results Here, we examined developmental, transcriptomic, and DNA methylation patterns during cold-shock-induced triploid embryogenesis in large yellow croaker ( Larimichthys crocea ). Triploid embryos exhibited approximately 1.51-fold higher DNA content and reached major developmental stages at times comparable with diploid controls. Across eight stages, developmental stage rather than ploidy dominated global RNA-seq variation, indicating broad preservation of relative transcriptome composition. Stage-wise comparisons identified localized transcriptional differences concentrated primarily at the blastula and heartbeat stages. Stage-by-ploidy interaction analysis revealed distinct developmental expression trajectories involving RNA processing, embryonic patterning, extracellular matrix organization, and contractile development. Whole-genome bisulfite sequencing at three stages revealed extensive and bidirectional regional methylation differences. Relative to analyzable genomic windows, differentially methylated regions showed non-random enrichment across genomic contexts, including particularly strong enrichment in CpG islands and promoters. However, methylation–expression correlations across promoter, gene-body, exonic, and intronic contexts were uniformly weak. Among RNA-testable differentially methylated genes, only seven genes at the blastula stage and two at the heartbeat stage were also differentially expressed, and these overlaps were not greater than expected under independence. Conclusions Cold-shock-induced triploid embryos therefore retain broadly preserved developmental progression and relative transcriptome organization while exhibiting localized transcriptional differences and extensive, genomically structured methylation remodeling. The limited same-stage correspondence between methylation and expression indicates that regional methylation differences are not broadly associated with concurrent transcriptional divergence in bulk embryos.

items.summary_zh: 物联网(IoT)中激增的流量, 影响了传感器等设备的数据传输。利用软件定义网络(SDN)技术可以优化网络性能, 提高数据传输质量。然而, 物联网中流量等网络状态的不断变化会影响软件定义网络控制平面的性能。研究软件定义物联网(SD-IoT)中的动态控制器部署问题, 以在流量变化时保证控制平面性能。考虑到物联网节点的能耗以及数据传输的特点, 在部署控制器时, 综合考虑延迟、控制可靠性以及能耗的影响, 并将该问题构建为马尔可夫博弈过程。为了同时兼顾单一控制器性能以及控制平面整体性能, 采用多智能体深度强化学习求解该问题。在部署阶段利用动作掩码屏蔽部分节点, 避免将控制器部署在性能不足或者供能不方便的节点。仿真实验表明, 与基于Louvain社区划分和基于单智能体深度Q网络(DQN)的部署算法相比, 所提算法可以更好地找到高性能的部署方案。

items.title: 云网融合环境下组合服务的动态重构

items.title: 基于多信息融合的高速收费站拥堵检测算法
items.title_zh: 基于多信息融合的高速收费站拥堵检测算法
items.summary_zh: 在高速收费站拥堵检测场景中, 遮挡、阴影、景深等因素严重影响检测算法的精度, 基于单信息的拥堵检测算法无法准确反映收费站真实拥堵情况, 对此, 提出一种高速收费站多信息融合拥堵检测算法。首先采用目标检测算法检测目标区域车辆, 利用图像空间特征计算车道占用率; 其次利用Deep SORT目标跟踪算法与滑动平衡机制进行车流量综合估计, 减少因为遮挡和阴影导致的车辆误检、漏检问题; 最后利用基于光流信息熵的车速估计方法, 降低因景深变化导致的拥堵状态检测误差。通过融合3种不同维度信息得到拥堵指数, 拥堵指数聚类为5种拥堵类别以判断真实拥堵状态, 从而实现高速收费站的拥堵检测。实验结果表明, 在高速收费站拥堵数据集上, 采用多信息融合的拥堵检测算法准确率达到90.4%, 能够实现对收费站拥堵状态的准确检测。

items.title: 大语言模型智能体操作系统研究综述
items.title_zh: 大语言模型智能体操作系统研究综述
items.summary_zh: 大语言模型智能体操作系统,也叫智能体操作系统,是整合大模型、工具资源以及多智能体协同的核心平台,目前正逐渐成为推动通用人工智能发展的一个关键研究方向。对智能体操作系统领域的研究进展进行了系统梳理,首先从基础理论着手,回顾了多种大模型的演进情况以及智能体和传统操作系统领域的进展;接着,围绕典型体系结构,如AIOS等,阐述了其分层架构与模块化设计是怎样达成资源管理与智能调度的。进一步地,明确了当前智能体操作系统在上下文整合、扩展性以及安全性等方面面临的技术挑战,同时也提出了未来借助轻量化设计、自监督学习机制以及动态调度算法来提升多智能体协作效率。该研究的主要贡献为,将那些分散的研究给予整合,促使技术框架变得更为明晰,并指出了智能体操作系统对新兴体系以及行业定制化实践覆盖不全面的情况。未来的研究需要侧重推动跨域智能体操作系统自我进化的能力,并且加快其在各个领域的落地等。

items.summary_zh: 近年来,大语言模型(Large Language Models,LLMs)技术迎来了快速发展,其在各行业的应用呈现出蓬勃增长的态势。从自然语言处理到智能推荐,再到信息检索和自动化写作,LLMs正逐渐成为许多领域中不可或缺的工具。然而,随着应用场景的逐渐多样化和需求的不断增加,LLMs推理效率问题日益凸显。在实际应用场景中,快速准确的推理能力对于响应用户请求、处理大规模数据和实时决策至关重要。为了应对这一挑战,学术界展开了广泛的研究和探索,致力于提高LLMs的推理效率。对此,全面调研了实际应用场景中有关LLMs高效推理的文献。首先,介绍了LLMs推理的原理,并分析了在实际应用场景中如何提高LLMs的推理效率。然后,引入了一个针对实际应用场景的分类系统,其主要分为3个层面,分别是算法优化层面、参数优化层面和系统优化层面;并对大模型进行相关研究的总结和归纳。最后,探讨了未来可能的研究方向。

items.title: scTGCL: A Transformer-Based Graph Contrastive Learning Approach for Efficiently Clustering Single-Cell RNA-seq Data
items.title_zh: scTGCL：一种基于 Transformer 的图对比学习方法，用于有效聚类单细胞 RNA-seq 数据
items.summary_zh: 动机：单细胞 RNA 测序 (scRNA-seq) 能够以前所未有的分辨率表征细胞异质性。然而，由于高维度、丢失引起的稀疏性和技术噪声，scRNA-seq 数据的准确聚类仍然具有挑战性。现有的对比学习方法通​​常通过扰乱基因表达值来创建增强视图，因此无法正确建模由丢失事件引起的细胞与细胞关系的不确定性。结果：我们提出了 scTGCL，这是一种新型的基于 Transformer 的图对比学习框架，可以直接从基因表达数据中学习稳健且有辨别力的细胞表示。 scTGCL 采用多头自注意力自适应地构建加权细胞-细胞图，并使用 Transformer 编码器从中生成细胞嵌入，捕获不同的生物关系。对于对比增强，我们将特征级基因屏蔽与注意力屏蔽一起应用，随机丢弃学习到的注意力矩阵的边缘，使模型能够承受丢失事件和技术噪音。对称对比损失最大化了原始表示和增强表示之间的一致性，而重建和插补损失的联合优化则保留了

extra.description: Motivation: Single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) enables characterization of cellular heterogeneity at unprecedented resolution. However, accurate clustering of scRNA-seq data remains challenging due to high dimensionality, dropout-induced sparsity, and technical noise. Existing contrastive learning methods usually create augmented views by perturbing gene expression values, so the uncertainty in cell-cell relationships caused by dropout events is not properly modeled. Results: We propose scTGCL, a novel Transformer-based graph contrastive learning framework that learns robust and discriminative cell representations directly from gene expression data. scTGCL employs multi-head self-attention to adaptively construct weighted cell-cell graphs and a Transformer encoder to generate cell embeddings from them, capturing diverse biological relationships. For contrastive augmentation, we apply feature-level gene masking together with attention masking that randomly drops edges of the learned attention matrices, enabling the model to withstand dropout events and technical noise. A symmetric contrastive loss maximizes agreement between original and augmented representations, while joint optimization with reconstruction and imputation losses preserves biological interpretability. Extensive experiments on twenty real and simulated scRNA-seq datasets demonstrate that scTGCL achieves the highest average performance among nine state-of-the-art baseline methods in clustering accuracy, normalized mutual information, and adjusted Rand index, while also achieving superior imputation performance and substantially lower runtime on large-scale datasets. Furthermore, biological analysis confirms that the learned clusters align with known cell types and yield biologically interpretable pathway enrichment, validating the utility of scTGCL for downstream cell annotation and marker gene discovery. Availability and Implementation: The source code and test data are freely available at GitHub (https://github.com/ShoaibAbdullahKhan/scTGCL)

items.title: Conformal Annotation with Randomized Expert Review: Application to Online Cell-Type Labeling
items.title_zh: 随机专家评审的保形注释：在线细胞类型标记的应用
items.summary_zh: 人工智能（AI）模型可以加速数字病理学中的细胞类型注释，但安全地扩展其使用需要通过错误控制来确定哪些模型生成的标签可以在没有专家审查的情况下被接受。这在不断发展的工作流程中具有挑战性，因为细胞形态和类型组成可能会随着组织区域和载玻片的变化而变化，从而使一次性校准变得不可靠。我们提出了分布偏移下随机专家审核的保形注释（CARED），这是一种无分布框架，利用随机专家审核来实现分布偏移下人工智能辅助注释的长期错误控制。对于每个传入批次，CARED 统一选择一部分案例进行专家评审，并使用获取的标签来校准后续决策。在未经审查的案例中，CARED 确定其中的一个子集以安全地跳过专家标签，同时为其他案例建议候选标签以供下游解决。我们证明，该工作流程提供了对整个流和审计样本之外的单元的累积误差的长期控制，而无需稳定性或可交换性假设。我们通过引入类条件保证来确保重要但罕见的细胞类型内的错误控制，以及一个实用

extra.description: Artificial intelligence (AI) models can accelerate cell-type annotation in digital pathology, but safely scaling their use requires determining, with error control, which model-generated labels can be accepted without expert review. This is challenging in evolving workflows because cell morphology and type composition may change across tissue regions and slides, making one-time calibration unreliable. We propose Conformal Annotation with Randomized Expert review under Distribution shift (CARED), a distribution-free framework that leverages randomized expert audit to achieve long-run error control for AI-assisted annotation under distribution shift. For each incoming batch, CARED uniformly selects a subset of cases for expert review and uses the acquired labels to calibrate later decisions. Among unreviewed cases, CARED determines a subset of them to safely skip expert labeling, while suggesting candidate labels for the others for downstream resolution. We prove that this workflow provides long-run control of cumulative error over both the full stream and the cells outside of the audit sample, without stationarity or exchangeability assumptions. We further enhance the framework by introducing class-conditional guarantees to ensure error control within important but rare cell types, together with a utility module to target more automatic resolutions, smaller candidate sets, and greater biological coherence, without compromising validity. Experiments on pancreas, lung, and ovary annotation streams, together with a stream constructed from real expert annotations, show that CARED controls the cumulative errors while a substantial fraction of cells (up to 70%) bypass expert review.

items.title: Zero-Complement Extrapolation: Parameter Recovery and Classification in Severely Imbalanced Logistic Regression under Rank-Deficient Regimes
items.title_zh: 零补外推：秩亏机制下严重不平衡逻辑回归的参数恢复和分类
items.summary_zh: 当少数类观测值的数量 ($n_1$) 小于特征维度 ($p$) 时，二元逻辑回归中的参数估计和分类会严重恶化。在这种等级不足的稀有性（$n_1 < p$）下，最大似然估计会遭受准完全分离，惩罚似然方法表现出严重的截距偏差，而凸少数过采样技术（例如 SMOTE）会崩溃到 $(n_1 - 1)$ 维仿射子空间。在本文中，我们提出了一种新颖的 \textit{自校准零补码} 估计器，它将范式从少数插值转变为多数边缘外推。基于斯坦因引理，我们证明由逻辑截断引起的丰富多数类（$Y=0$）的条件期望转变唯一地标识了马哈拉诺比斯白化后的真实超平面法线$\boldsymbolβ$。我们进一步确定，沿着共轭方向从多数分布的高分位数密度边缘向外推断合成少数实例可以保留满秩协方差正则性（$\mathrm{rank} = p$）。为了适应半监督环境（具有未标记的背景平均值）和严格监督的子样本，我们引入了一种混合估

extra.description: Parameter estimation and classification in binary logistic regression deteriorate severely when the number of minority class observations ($n_1$) is smaller than the feature dimension ($p$). Under such rank-deficient rarity ($n_1 < p$), maximum likelihood estimators suffer from quasi-complete separation, penalized likelihood methods exhibit severe intercept bias, and convex minority oversampling techniques such as SMOTE collapse into an $(n_1 - 1)$-dimensional affine subspace. In this paper, we propose a novel \textit{Self-Calibrated Zero-Complement} estimator that shifts the paradigm from minority interpolation to majority fringe extrapolation. Grounded in Stein's Lemma, we prove that the conditional expectation shift of the abundant majority class ($Y=0$) induced by logistic truncation uniquely identifies the true hyperplane normal $\boldsymbolβ$ after Mahalanobis whitening. We further establish that extrapolating synthetic minority instances outward from the high-quantile density fringe of the majority distribution along the conjugate direction preserves full-rank covariance regularity ($\mathrm{rank} = p$). To accommodate both semi-supervised environments (with an unlabeled background mean) and strictly supervised subsamples, we introduce a hybrid estimator incorporating the intrinsic third-moment skewness of the majority class alongside a location-shift-invariant zero-boundary intercept calibration. Extensive Monte Carlo simulations and real-world benchmark applications (Wisconsin Diagnostic Breast Cancer and Banknote Authentication) under extreme rarity ($n_1 \in \{3, 5\}$) demonstrate that our approach prevents parameter divergence, recovers the oracle hyperplane with high fidelity, and substantially outperforms Firth's regression and SMOTE in F1-score and estimation stability.

items.title: HELICS: Biobank-scale Conditional Synthetic Genome Generation via Latent Flow Matching
items.title_zh: HELICS：通过潜在流匹配进行生物样本库规模的条件合成基因组生成
items.summary_zh: 个体水平基因型数据支撑遗传发现、疾病风险建模和治疗开发，然而许多关键场景仍数据有限，包括代表性不足的祖先群体、罕见或不平衡疾病队列以及受限访问的生物样本库。条件合成基因组生成将支持隐私感知的基准测试、模拟和数据增强，但需要学习数十万至数千万相关单核苷酸多态性（SNPs，即DNA变异位点）上的超高维离散分布。我们引入HELICS：通过潜在插值条件合成的高保真生成，一个无定相潜在流匹配框架，用于从生物样本库规模基因型数据进行全基因组SNP水平生成。HELICS用卷积自编码器对染色体进行标记化，将>600K SNPs缩减为4,096个连续潜在标记，并在拼接的多染色体潜在表示上训练参数化条件流匹配的transformer模型。在英国生物样本库超过417K基因组上训练，HELICS无需单倍型定相即可生成全基因组常见变异合成队列，并比现有基于单倍型的模拟器更忠实于真实基因型，包括外部评估中高等位基因频

extra.description: Individual-level genotype data underpin genetic discovery, disease-risk modeling, and therapeutic development, yet many critical settings remain data-limited, including underrepresented ancestries, rare or imbalanced disease cohorts, and restricted-access biobanks. Conditional synthetic genome generation would support privacy-aware benchmarking, simulation, and data augmentation, but requires learning an ultra-high-dimensional discrete distribution over hundreds of thousands to tens of millions of correlated single-nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs), or sites of DNA variation. We introduce HELICS: High-fidelity gEneration via Latent Interpolant Conditional Synthesis, a phasing-free latent flow matching framework for genome-wide SNP-level generation from biobank-scale genotype data. HELICS tokenizes chromosomes with convolutional autoencoders, reducing >600K SNPs to 4,096 continuous latent tokens, and trains a transformer parameterized conditional flow matching model over the concatenated multi-chromosome latent representation. Trained on over 417K genomes in the UK Biobank, HELICS generates genome-wide common-variant synthetic cohorts without haplotype phasing and achieves stronger fidelity to real genotypes than existing haplotype-based simulators, including high allele-frequency agreement in external evaluation and superior preservation of local and long-range SNP correlation structure. Conditioning on ancestry and genetic liability summaries enables targeted generation across genetic risk profiles; in perturbation analyses, by increasing the conditioned disease trait liability, HELICS induces SNP-level dosage changes in generated genomes that are highly correlated with published association weights. HELICS provides a scalable generative modeling framework for SNP-level genome data and a path toward conditional synthetic cohorts for data-limited genetic studies.

items.title: Building computational benchmarks: an Omnibenchmark reimplementation of a single-cell preprocessing pipeline evaluation
items.title_zh: 构建计算基准：单细胞预处理管道评估的 Omnibenchmark 重新实现
items.summary_zh: 背景：在过去的几年中，我们看到单细胞（例如 RNA 测序）技术和数据集的真正激增，使得跨组织和条件的细胞异质性的表征变得越来越详细。单细胞技术的激增得到了大量分析框架和流程、大参数空间和研究人员使用它们的自由度的补充。已经针对各种计算任务提出了许多中性基准，但大多数做出的设计决策使它们彼此不兼容，例如通过使用不同的数据集、指标或参数集。结果：我们展示了 Omnibenchmark，这是一个最近开发的框架，用于为长臂基准构建可重复、可扩展和标准化的方法比较，该基准在三个数据集上评估五个单细胞 RNA 测序流程，涵盖过滤、归一化、降维和聚类。该框架有助于对单细胞数据分析中使用的管道进行广泛调查，同时强调如何简化和统一构建基准的过程。这种标准化使基准测试能够在多个方向上扩展，包括更广泛的参数扫描、软件版本和架构之间的比较、管道步骤的隔离以及附加管道、数据集和指标的集成。例如，我们对管道的协调强调

extra.description: Background: In the past few years, we have seen a veritable surge in single-cell (e.g., RNA-sequencing) techniques and datasets, enabling increasingly detailed characterization of cellular heterogeneity across tissues and conditions. This surge in single-cell techniques has been complemented by a large number of analysis frameworks and pipelines, and a large parameter space and researcher degrees of freedom to use them. Many neutral benchmarks have been presented for various computational tasks, but most make design decisions that render them incompatible with each other, e.g., through the use of different datasets, metrics, or parameter sets. Results: We showcase Omnibenchmark, a recently developed framework to build reproducible, extensible, and standardized method comparisons for an arms-length benchmark that evaluates five single-cell RNA sequencing pipelines, spanning filtering, normalization, dimensionality reduction, and clustering, on three datasets. The framework facilitates the broad investigation of pipelines used in single-cell data analysis while highlighting how the process of building benchmarks can be streamlined and unified. This standardization enables benchmarks to be extended in several directions, including broader parameter sweeps, comparisons across software versions and architectures, isolation of pipeline steps, and integration of additional pipelines, datasets, and metrics. As an example, our harmonization of pipelines highlighted that tools implement the (clustering) resolution parameter differently. Conclusions: Omnibenchmark provides a reproducible, extensible, and standardized approach for benchmarking. By unifying the process of benchmark construction, it can facilitate more consistent method comparisons and provides a foundation for broader, more flexible, and more sustainable benchmarking efforts.

items.title: An autoencoder outperforms two transformers on prediction of gene expression from chromatin accessibility
items.title_zh: 自编码器在从染色质可及性预测基因表达上优于两个 transformer
items.summary_zh: 从染色质可及性预测 RNA 丰度的模型很少在相同特征、目标和指标下比较。我们在来自 19 项人类研究的 126,604 个配对单核图谱上构建了一个基准，共享 50,000 个峰和 3,185 个基因的词表、十个 5x2 交叉验证折和一个评分目标，并在 70 次训练运行中比较了七个已实现流程和两个参考预测器；每个流程保留自己的输入归一化和原生训练目标。基于双变分自编码器的 scButterfly-B 流程在所有六十个配对折比较中，在每基因和细胞内 Spearman 相关上优于所有 transformer 流程，包括自回归 Perceiver 模型（Omic Translator）和无支持重构的 Cisformer，训练时间短 3.8 倍。Transformer 流程在细胞内轮廓形状上差距为 0.02-0.04，但在每基因相关上落后 0.10-0.24。在两个留出细胞类型上每基因相关较低；对照

extra.description: Models that predict RNA abundance from chromatin accessibility are rarely compared under the same features, targets and metrics. We built one benchmark on 126,604 paired single-nucleus profiles from 19 human studies with a shared vocabulary of 50,000 peaks and 3,185 genes, ten 5x2 cross-validation folds and one scoring target, and compared seven implemented pipelines and two reference predictors across 70 trained runs; each pipeline keeps its own input normalisation and native training target. The scButterfly-B pipeline, built on dual variational autoencoders, outperformed every transformer pipeline, including an autoregressive Perceiver model (Omic Translator) and a support-free reformulation of Cisformer, on per-gene and within-cell Spearman correlation in all sixty paired fold comparisons, with 3.8 times shorter training. Transformer pipelines come within 0.02-0.04 on within-cell profile shape but lag by 0.10-0.24 on per-gene correlation. On two withheld cell types per-gene correlation is low; controls show the podocyte values are typical of within-type correlation for seen cell types of the same size, whereas Paneth values match a cell-agnostic shuffle for every Omic Translator arm. Within the transformer family, prespecified ablations show the Perceiver encoder was worth +0.0439 in within-donor per-gene correlation over full self-attention, a chromosome-aware genomic attention prior reduced it by 0.0096 (exact donor-level sign-flip test, Holm-adjusted p = 1.2e-4), and decoder output order had no detectable effect. A training-mean profile reaches 0.314 within-cell correlation with no input and a constant at the true expressed-gene positions reaches 0.996 per-gene correlation, so oracle-support protocols are reported only as diagnostics. Code, results and an audited release are provided.

items.title: OmicsBench: a long-horizon multi-turn benchmark of AI agents on research-study-scale bioinformatics
items.title_zh: OmicsBench：AI智能体在研究级生物信息学上的长时程多轮基准
items.summary_zh: 计算生物学家越来越多地将大量分析委托给AI智能体进行长时程、多轮会话，但大多数智能体生物信息学能力基准只提出单一短任务和单次提示。我们提出OmicsBench，一个面向AI智能体的长时程、多轮生物信息学基准。其97个任务各自将依赖子任务连接成有向无环图，总共662个底层子任务。每个子任务作为一个用户轮次提出，并针对答案键进行确定性评分，对错误答案提供可选的上下文反馈。在三种框架上的12个模型中，最慢的智能体平均每任务耗时3.6小时，没有任何组合接近饱和该基准，无上下文反馈时平均得分为0.43至0.57（满分1），有反馈时为0.54至0.67。多轮评估还揭示了单次提示无法发现的行为，因为智能体在依赖早期子任务的子任务上得分较低，而上下文反馈帮助智能体挽回部分损失。由于确定性评分无法定性说明智能体如何失败，我们还引入了一个无监督失败模式发现流程，用于描述、嵌入和聚类智能体的失败尝试，以揭示涌现

extra.description: Computational biologists increasingly delegate substantial analyses to AI agents in long-horizon, multi-turn sessions, yet most benchmarks of agents' bioinformatics capabilities pose a single short task with a single-shot prompt. We present OmicsBench, a long-horizon, multi-turn bioinformatics benchmark for AI agents. Each of its 97 tasks links dependent subtasks into a directed acyclic graph, for 662 underlying subtasks in all. Each subtask is posed as one user turn and graded deterministically against an answer key, with optional in-context feedback on incorrect answers. Across 12 models on three harnesses, the slowest agent averages 3.6 hours per task, and no combination comes near saturating the benchmark, with mean scores of 0.43 to 0.57 out of a possible 1 without in-context feedback and 0.54 to 0.67 with it. Multi-turn evaluation also uncovers behavior that single-shot prompts cannot, as agents score lower on subtasks that depend on earlier subtasks, and in-context feedback helps agents recover some of that loss. Because deterministic scoring gives no qualitative account of how an agent failed, we also introduce an unsupervised failure mode discovery pipeline that describes, embeds, and clusters agents' failed attempts to surface emergent failure modes. Applied to OmicsBench, this pipeline exposes qualitative shortcomings in how agents carry out bioinformatics analyses, ranging from agents applying their own statistical filters in place of the specified ones to agents writing whole answers from memory.

items.title: FTO does not function as an m6A eraser in AML: a reassessment using direct RNA nanopore sequencing
items.title_zh: FTO 在 AML 中不起 m6A 橡皮擦的作用：使用直接 RNA 纳米孔测序进行重新评估
items.summary_zh: 表观转录组学的一个核心概念是 RNA 去甲基酶 FTO 作为特定 mRNA 中 N6-甲基腺苷 (m6A) 的位点选择性擦除器。这在急性髓系白血病 (AML) 中最为明确，其中 MYC 去甲基化被认为会促进白血病的发生。使用纳米孔直接 RNA 测序对整个 m6A 转录组进行定量，我们发现 m6A 化学计量（包括 MYC 特异性位点）仍然不受 AML 中 FTO 敲低或药物抑制的影响。相反，snRNA 中 N6-2'-O-二甲基腺苷 (m6Am) 的水平显着增加，表明 m6Am，而不是 m6A，是 AML 中 FTO 的主要底物。我们将这些结果扩展到 AML 背景之外的 FTO 敲除大脑和 HEK293T 细胞中，检测到 mRNA m6A 没有选择性增加，但在 FTO 耗尽后 snRNA m6Am 水平普遍增加。这些发现表明 FTO 擦除 mRNA 中 m6A 的能力极小。相反，据报道 FT

extra.description: A central concept in epitranscriptomics is that the RNA demethylase FTO acts as a site-selective eraser of N6-methyladenosine (m6A) in specific mRNAs. This is most well-established in acute myeloid leukemia (AML), where demethylation of MYC is thought to promote leukemogenesis. Using nanopore direct RNA sequencing to quantify m6A transcriptome-wide, we find that m6A stoichiometry, including at MYC-specific sites, remains unaffected by FTO knockdown or pharmacologic inhibition in AML. Conversely, levels of N6-2'-O-dimethyladenosine (m6Am) are markedly increased in snRNAs, indicating that m6Am, not m6A, is the major substrate of FTO in AML. We extend these results outside the AML context in FTO knockout brain and HEK293T cells, detecting no selective increases in mRNA m6A but widespread increases in snRNA m6Am levels following FTO depletion. These findings suggest that FTO has minimal ability to erase m6A in mRNA. Instead, the reported biological effects of FTO are likely mediated by demethylation of m6Am.

items.title: ProtAgent: Post-Training Compact Protein Tool Agents with Interaction-Level Credit Assignment
items.title_zh: ProtAgent：具有交互级信用分配的训练后紧凑蛋白质工具代理
items.summary_zh: 蛋白质注释代理必须选择合适的生物信息学工具，解释其输出，并在最终答案中使用所得证据。大多数现有系统依赖前沿规模模型。我们询问紧凑模型是否可以通过与真实工具交互的后训练来学习这种行为。我们提出ProtAgent，一个两阶段流水线，使用监督微调（SFT）学习工具接口，并使用标准同策略REINFORCE改进交互策略。中间工具调用获得动作奖励，最终响应获得终端答案奖励。步级回报将这些奖励分配给产生它们的响应以及之前的动作。回合级基线则为每个动作分配一个回合回报。在具有真实生物信息学工具的固定闭环协议上，ProtAgent-8B在注释覆盖率指标下达到61.00%的成功率，而DeepSeek-V3.2-Thinking 671B为41.60%，最强评估前沿系统为60.80%。在三种子比较中，在恒等回报归一化下，回合级回报的平均成功率为42.70%，步级回报为61.40%；相应的组相对结果分别为36.5

extra.description: Protein annotation agents must choose suitable bioinformatics tools, interpret their outputs, and use the resulting evidence in the final answer. Most existing systems rely on frontier-scale models. We ask whether a compact model can instead learn this behavior through post-training with real tool interaction. We present ProtAgent, a two-stage pipeline that uses supervised fine-tuning (SFT) to learn the tool interface and standard on-policy REINFORCE to improve the interaction policy. Intermediate tool calls receive action rewards, and the final response receives a terminal answer reward. Step-level returns assign these rewards to the responses that produced them and to preceding actions. The episode-level baseline instead assigns one episode return to every action. On a fixed closed-loop protocol with real bioinformatics tools, ProtAgent-8B achieves 61.00% success under the annotation-coverage metric, compared with 41.60% for DeepSeek-V3.2-Thinking 671B and 60.80% for the strongest evaluated frontier system. In the three-seed comparison, mean success is 42.70% with episode-level returns and 61.40% with step-level returns under identity return normalization; the corresponding group-relative results are 36.50% and 58.20%. The metric measures recovery of reference annotations under this protocol; it does not by itself establish biological correctness or complete evidence grounding.

items.title: BARRR: Bidimensional Augmented Reduced Rank Regression for Multi-View Multi-Cohort Data
items.title_zh: BARRR：用于多视图多队列数据的双向增强降秩回归
items.summary_zh: 跨多个队列（即样本组）和视图（即来源或模态）的双向数据整合在生物医学研究中至关重要，以从异质数据集中获得整体见解。然而，大多数现有整合方法侧重于单一维度，如跨不同来源的多视图整合或跨不同样本组的多队列整合。现有的双向整合方法稀缺且主要无监督，忽视了协变量提供的宝贵见解。为解决这一空白，我们引入双向增强降秩回归（baRRR）方法。我们的方法同时建模协变量相关和不相关效应，同时在两个维度上分解效应水平（全局、部分共享和个体）。大量模拟证明了我们的方法在信号恢复、结果预测和缺失数据插补方面的优势。我们将方法应用于癌症基因组图谱（TCGA）数据，使用体细胞突变作为协变量来告知不同组学平台和癌症类型间的变异模式。这些研究突出了其作为生物医学研究中稳健且适应性强的整合分析工具的潜力。

extra.description: Bidimensional data integration across multiple cohorts (i.e., sample groups) and views (i.e., sources or modalities) is crucial in biomedical research to derive holistic insights from heterogeneous datasets. However, most existing integrative methods focus on a single dimension, such as multi-view integration across distinct sources or multi-cohort integration across distinct sample groups. Existing approaches for bidimensional integration are scarce and predominantly unsupervised, overlooking the valuable insights offered by covariates. To address this gap, we introduce the Bidimensional Augmented Reduced Rank Regression (baRRR) method. Our approach models covariate-related and unrelated effects concurrently, while also decomposing effect levels (global, partially shared, and individual) across both dimensions. Extensive simulations demonstrate the advantages of our method with respect to signal recovery, outcome prediction, and missing data imputation. We apply our approach to data from The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA), using somatic mutations as covariates to inform patterns of variability across different omics platforms and cancer types. These studies highlight its potential as a robust and adaptable tool for integrative analysis in biomedical research.

items.title: Reducing double-dipping in single-cell topic models with three-way count splitting
items.title_zh: 用三向计数拆分减少单细胞主题模型中的双重 dipping
items.summary_zh: 主题模型从单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）数据中学习基因程序，然后相同的计数被用于测试哪些基因和供体与这些程序相关。计数拆分是这种复用的标准补救措施，但当编码器读取每个细胞的计数时尚未被测试。在一个104,400细胞的狼疮队列中，每次运行300个置换零基因，朴素检验在名义5%水平下拒绝了36%的零基因-主题对，而通常的两向拆分拒绝了38%，因为编码器看到了被检验基因自身的留出计数。在单独的第三个计数上编码主题使用，使用beta-二项稀疏化，将此降低到7.7%（模型外基因为6.7%）；对于另外两个模型LDVAE和scETM，该率为7.0-7.3%（朴素为51-59%）。一个无标签干扰素程序在狼疮队列和预先指定的COVID-19队列的留出计数中发生偏移，供体水平主题使用预测疾病（AUROC 0.96），超越细胞类型比例（两个队列中分别为0.86和0.58）。校准和预测不依赖于模型。我们不

extra.description: Topic models learn gene programs from single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) data, and the same counts are then used to test which genes and donors are associated with those programs. Count splitting is the standard remedy for this reuse, but it has not been tested when an encoder reads each cell's counts. On a 104,400-cell lupus cohort with 300 permuted null genes per run, naive tests rejected 36% of null gene-topic pairs at a nominal 5% level, and the usual two-way split rejected 38%, because the encoder sees the tested gene's own held-out count. Encoding topic usage on a separate third of the counts, with beta-binomial thinning, lowered this to 7.7% (6.7% for genes outside the model); for two other models, LDVAE and scETM, the rate was 7.0-7.3% (naive 51-59%). A label-free interferon program shifts in held-out counts in the lupus cohort and in a pre-specified COVID-19 cohort, and donor-level topic usage predicts disease (AUROC 0.96) beyond cell-type proportions (0.86 and 0.58 in the two cohorts). Calibration and prediction did not depend on the model. We do not claim better clustering, prediction or topic stability. Code, figures and result tables are public (MIT license; DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23307193).

items.title: Understanding Gene Expression-to-Image Learning: Spatial Structure and Information Fidelity
items.title_zh: 理解基因表达到图像学习：空间结构与信息保真度
items.summary_zh: 单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）使生物异质性的细胞水平分析成为可能，但从高维、无序基因表达谱学习有效表示仍具挑战性。基因表达到图像（GE2I）通过将基因值排列在像素网格上供卷积神经网络使用，提供了一种有效学习策略，但其潜在机制仍不清楚。我们在全转录组数据上研究GE2I，同时保持网络和训练过程固定。我们的结果揭示了空间平滑性与基因级保真度之间的权衡。结构化映射产生平滑的低频模式，支持更快的早期优化，而将多个基因分配到同一像素会模糊表达差异并可能降低预测性能。这种权衡解释了为什么当表示许多基因时，随机映射可以与结构化布局竞争。即使图像平滑性降低，一对一基因到像素分配在测试的视觉骨干网络中也能改善预测。我们进一步发现预训练和增强的益处取决于骨干网络和映射。这些发现为像素分配和将视觉先验迁移到基因表达数据提供了实用指导。

extra.description: Single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) enables cell-level analysis of biological heterogeneity, but learning effective representations from high-dimensional, unordered gene expression profiles remains challenging. Gene Expression-to-Image (GE2I) offers an effective learning strategy by arranging gene values on pixel grids for convolutional neural networks, but its underlying mechanisms remain unclear. We study GE2I on full-transcriptome data while keeping the network and training procedure fixed. Our results reveal a trade-off between spatial smoothness and gene-level fidelity. Structured mappings produce smooth, low-frequency patterns that support faster early optimization, whereas assigning multiple genes to the same pixel obscures expression differences and can reduce predictive performance. This trade-off explains why random mappings can compete with structured layouts when many genes are represented. One-to-one gene-to-pixel assignment improves prediction across the tested visual backbones even when image smoothness decreases. We further find that the benefits of pretraining and augmentation depend on the backbone and mapping. These findings provide practical guidance for pixel allocation and the transfer of vision priors to gene expression data.

items.title: Predictive Multiplicity in Cell-Fate Assignment: Label-Free Rashomon Sets and the Limits of Per-Cell Certification
items.title_zh: 细胞命运分配中的预测多重性：无标签 Rashomon 集和逐细胞认证的局限
items.summary_zh: 单细胞轨迹推断将转录组测量映射到发育连续体上，但同样拟合数据的配置可能分配冲突的细胞命运。FateMultiplicity 是一个无标签框架，通过评估交叉拟合留出基因上的模型差异，在非劣效性测试下针对随机种子变异进行校准，构建统计可接受的模型集或 Rashomon 集，无需谱系标签。多重性很大，更多取决于模型空间的多样性而非其大小：第二个算法的十二种配置暴露 20.0% 的细胞，而第一个算法的二十四种配置暴露 3.8%。然后测试逐细胞认证命运边际 FM 是否比拟合模型已提供的产生更可靠的分配，结果并非如此。在模拟真实值上，在相同细胞上，FM 以 AUC 0.682 区分错误分配，而基线配置自身的决策边际为 0.965（p = 0.003），种子离散基线为 0.854。信息量由所接纳集的广度而非其基数决定：在基数四时，种子重拟合给出 0.933，超参数扰动集给出 0.701。将下确界放宽到

extra.description: Single-cell trajectory inference maps transcriptomic measurements onto developmental continua, yet configurations that fit the data equally well can assign conflicting cell fates. FateMultiplicity is a label-free framework that constructs a statistically admissible model set, or Rashomon set, without lineage labels, by evaluating model discrepancy on cross-fitted held-out genes under non-inferiority testing calibrated against random-seed variation. Multiplicity is large and depends more on the diversity of the model space than its size: twelve configurations of a second algorithm expose 20.0% of cells where twenty-four of the first expose 3.8%. Whether the per-cell certified fate margin FM yields more reliable assignments than the fitted model already provides is then tested, and it does not. On simulation ground truth, on the same cells, FM discriminates misassignment at AUC 0.682, against 0.965 for the baseline configuration's own decision margin (p = 0.003) and 0.854 for a seed-dispersion baseline. Informativeness is governed by the breadth of the admitted set, not its cardinality: at cardinality four, seed refits give 0.933 and hyperparameter-perturbed sets 0.701. Relaxing the infimum to a q-quantile recovers discrimination but converges toward the single model's own confidence; the supremum reaches 0.973 because theta*'s membership bounds it from below, while the infimum is unanchored. Multiplicity in trajectory inference is worth measuring and reporting, but per-cell certification over a label-free Rashomon set is not a route to more reliable fate calls. Two constructions survive: a margin-erosion ratio separates real from spurious branch points in simulation (AUC 0.890, untested on real data), and against clonally observed fate, uncertified cells disagree with their clone's outcome 16.4 percentage points more often than certified cells (p < 0.001).

items.title: Protocol for Discovering Convergent Molecular Networks across Multi-Omics Datasets Using Network Propagation
items.title_zh: 使用网络传播跨多组学数据集发现趋同分子网络的方案
items.summary_zh: 表型结果源于分子层之间的协调变化。尽管多组学数据捕捉互补的分子信号，但由于基因水平重叠有限，将其整合为连贯的生物机制仍然具有挑战性。网络传播将每个数据集中的重要基因命中映射到先验知识分子相互作用网络上，并将其信号扩散到邻近基因。对传播网络进行数学整合，随后进行聚类和通路富集，可揭示共享分子网络，从而指出跨正交分子层捕捉到的核心生物学。

extra.description: Phenotypic outcomes arise from coordinated changes across molecular layers. Although multi-omics data capture complementary molecular signals, integrating them into coherent biological mechanisms remains challenging due to limited overlap at the gene level. Network propagation maps significant gene hits from each dataset onto a prior knowledge molecular interaction network and diffuses their signals to neighboring genes. Mathematical integration of propagated networks, followed by clustering and pathway enrichment, reveals shared molecular networks, pinpointing the core biology captured across orthogonal molecular layers.

items.title: Read, Allocate, Route: Role-Coupled Tokenization for Pixel-Space Generative Transformers
items.title_zh: 读取、分配、路由：像素空间生成变压器的角色耦合标记化
items.summary_zh: 像素空间生成 Transformer 通常每个图像块使用一个令牌，因此捕获更精细的细节需要更多令牌，并使全局注意力变得越来越昂贵。我们观察到，更精细的细节不一定需要更多的全局通信：低频结构受益于全局交换，而高频细节可以在本地建模。基于这一见解，我们引入了 SpecSlot，一种像素空间整流流 Transformer，它将输出细节与全局注意力序列的长度解耦。 SpecSlot 将每个空间锚点扩展为多个时隙，每个时隙分配一个不相交的 DCT 系数带；这将锚密度与光谱细分分开。只有每个锚点的最低频率时隙参与全局注意力，而所有时隙都在本地交互。这使得模型能够在不扩大全局序列的情况下增加光谱细节。空间头进一步向光谱预测添加局部校正，而生成状态、目标和损失保留在像素空间中。在 ImageNet-256 上，SpecSlot 实现了与 FLOPs 匹配的 JiT 控制相当的最终 FID，同时收敛速度更快

extra.description: Pixel-space generative Transformers typically use one token per image patch, so capturing finer detail requires more tokens and makes global attention increasingly expensive. We observe that finer detail does not necessarily require more global communication: low-frequency structure benefits from global exchange, while high-frequency detail can be modeled locally. Based on this insight, we introduce SpecSlot, a pixel-space rectified-flow Transformer that decouples output detail from the length of the global attention sequence. SpecSlot expands each spatial anchor into multiple slots, each assigned a disjoint band of DCT coefficients; this separates anchor density from spectral subdivision. Only the lowest-frequency slot from each anchor participates in global attention, while all slots interact locally. This allows the model to increase spectral detail without enlarging the global sequence. A spatial head further adds a local correction to the spectral prediction, while the generative state, target, and loss remain in pixel space. On ImageNet-256, SpecSlot achieves a comparable final FID to a FLOPs-matched JiT control while converging faster. On ImageNet-512, it improves FID by 2.84 over the control with 3.9% fewer FLOPs, and comes within only 0.69 FID of JiT-B/16 at 38.2% lower cost. On text-to-image generation, SpecSlot surpasses JiT-B/8 on DPG-Bench by 1.06 at 40.6% lower forward cost.

items.title: Luggage re-identification: A study of strategies towards a real-world application
items.title_zh: 行李重新识别：现实世界应用策略的研究
items.summary_zh: 行李重新识别 (ReID) 是取证、安全或边境管理（可疑或遗弃行李识别）以及行李管理（丢失行李找回）视频监控中的一项关键任务。它能够在机场、火车站和边境口岸等复杂环境中通过不相交的摄像机视图关联相同行李的观察结果。虽然现有的方法主要关注相对干净的条件下基于外观的裁剪图像匹配，但现实场景的特点是频繁的遮挡、杂乱的背景和拥挤的场景，这会显着降低性能。然而，利用不同视频流的多个镜头和视图的互补性的策略却被忽视了。在本文中，我们研究了端到端管道的策略，该管道通过多个视频流进行操作以检测和重新识别行李。我们评估在现实环境中获取的基准数据集的不同变体，以解决选择和合并同一行李的不同视图和镜头的问题，以及对不同环境数据集进行训练，以提高实际应用中的整体 ReID 性能。

extra.description: Luggage re-identification (ReID) is a critical task in video surveillance for forensics, security or border management (suspicious or abandoned luggage recognition), as well as luggage management (lost luggage recovery). It enables the association of observations of the same luggage across disjoint camera views in complex environments such as airports, train stations and border crossing. While existing approaches primarily focus on appearance-based cropped image matching under relatively clean conditions, real-world scenarios are characterized by frequent occlusions, cluttered background and crowded scenes which significantly degrade performance. Yet, strategies leveraging the complementarity of multiple shots and views from different video streams is overlooked. In this paper, we study strategies for an end-to-end pipeline that operates from multiple video streams to detect and re-identify luggage. We evaluate different variants on a benchmark dataset acquired in real-world environments to address the questions of selecting and merging different views and shots of the same luggage as well as training on different environment datasets for an overall ReID performance improvement in practical applications.

items.title: world2vec: Mechanistic world models through latent dynamics learning
items.title_zh: world2vec：通过潜在动力学学习的机械世界模型
items.summary_zh: 世界模型可以在不忠实捕捉环境动态的情况下实现强大的控制性能，从而限制了其机械解释和科学发现的潜力。在这里，我们引入 world2vec 来学习机械世界模型，而无需直接从观察和行动中获取奖励信息。 World2vec 学习潜在的动力学，可以在较长的预测范围内忠实地再现真实系统，其参数比 DreamerV3、TD-MPC2 和 LeWM 至少少一个数量级。这使得在通过像素控制连续环境和跨 71 个吸引子基准的准确系统识别方面实现最先进的性能，展示了世界模型如何服从于科学发现。

extra.description: World models can achieve strong control performance without faithfully capturing the dynamics of their environment, limiting their potential for mechanistic interpretability and scientific discovery. Here, we introduce world2vec to learn mechanistic world models without reward information directly from observations and actions. World2vec learns latent dynamics that faithfully reproduce the true system over long prediction horizons, with at least one order of magnitude fewer parameters than DreamerV3, TD-MPC2 and LeWM. This enables state of the art performance in controlling continuous environments from pixels and accurate system identification across a benchmark of 71 attractors, demonstrating how world models are amenable to scientific discovery.

items.title: Probing Spatial State Representations in Visual Foundation Models
items.title_zh: 探索视觉基础模型中的空间状态表示
items.summary_zh: 观察者只能看到周围世界的一部分，但必须跟踪当前视野之外的事物。因此，空间感知不仅仅涉及识别单个图像：它需要持续的空间状态，该状态在自我运动下更新并用于指导行动。视觉基础模型是否提供支持这种状态的表示？我们通过四个级别的空间能力（空间结构、对象持久性、预测空间更新和可操作性）来研究这个问题，在静态室内环境的流式自我中心观察下，使用冻结特征探针对十种表示进行研究。生成的功能配置文件因任务、网络层和前缀长度而异：可见场景的强读出并不能确保准确的对象持久性或未来特征检索。匹配的控件将读数准确性与对视觉历史和运动的依赖分开。本机未来预测保留了可恢复的空间结构，但接受真实特征训练的空间读取器不会不变地转移到预测特征。最后，依赖于目标的候选者选择并不能建立可靠的连续行动效用：预测行动响应目标变化，但提供正确的目标并不能可靠地提高进度。在这四个级别中，对象持久性和可操作性建立在相机姿势读出的基础上，而特征

extra.description: An observer sees only part of the surrounding world, yet must keep track of what lies beyond the current view. Spatial perception therefore involves more than recognizing individual images: it calls for a persistent spatial state that is updated under self-motion and used to guide action. Do visual foundation models provide representations that support such a state? We study this question through four levels of spatial capability---spatial structure, object persistence, predictive spatial update, and actionability---using frozen-feature probes on ten representations under streaming egocentric observations of static indoor environments. The resulting capability profiles vary across tasks, network layers, and prefix lengths: strong readout of the visible scene does not ensure accurate object persistence or future-feature retrieval. Matched controls separate readout accuracy from reliance on visual history and motion. Native future prediction retains recoverable spatial structure, but a spatial reader trained on real features does not transfer to predicted features unchanged. Finally, goal-dependent candidate selection does not establish reliable continuous action utility: predicted actions respond to goal changes, yet supplying the correct goal does not reliably improve progress. Across the four levels, object persistence and actionability build on camera-pose readout, whereas feature prediction builds on visible-scene readout. Together, these findings motivate evaluating spatial representations not only by what can be decoded from them, but by whether that information is maintained beyond observation, updated predictively, and used for goal-directed action.

items.title: An ODE-based Sampler for Discrete Diffusion Models
items.title_zh: 基于常微分方程的离散扩散模型采样器
items.summary_zh: 连续扩散模型的边际可以通过确定性常微分方程 (ODE) 来重现，称为概率流 ODE，它为加速采样和一致性蒸馏提供了基础。在本文中，我们解决了离散扩散模型是否存在类似公式的问题，并通过引入指数剩余流（ERF）给出了肯定的答案。我们的框架通过每个标记和位置的连续残差变量来增强离散状态。这些残差根据分段定义的 ODE 确定性地演化，其向量场取决于当前离散状态以及指定扩散模型的前向和后向速率矩阵。每当残差达到零时，离散状态就会发生变化。我们证明这种构造保留了原始扩散的边缘。我们对采样器进行了实用的离散化，并将其专门用于屏蔽和均匀扩散。 ERF 的确定性轨迹支持一致性蒸馏，并在各种基准（包括代码和文本生成任务）上比以前的方法产生了实证改进。

extra.description: The marginals of a continuous diffusion model can be reproduced by a deterministic ordinary differential equation (ODE), known as the probability flow ODE, which provides a foundation for accelerated sampling and consistency distillation. In this paper we address the question whether an analogous formulation exists for discrete diffusion models and answer it affirmatively by introducing exponential residual flows (ERFs). Our framework augments the discrete state with a continuous residual variable for each token and position. These residuals evolve deterministically according to piecewise-defined ODEs whose vector fields depend on the current discrete state and the forward and backward rate matrices of the prescribed diffusion model. The discrete state changes whenever a residual reaches zero. We prove that this construction preserves the marginals of the original diffusion. We derive a practical discretization of our sampler and specialize it to masked and uniform diffusion. The deterministic trajectories of ERFs support consistency distillation and yield empirical improvements over previous approaches across a variety of benchmarks including code and text generation tasks.

items.title: Multistatic ISAC with Deep Learning-Based Clutter Suppression for 5G and Beyond
items.title_zh: 具有基于深度学习的杂波抑制功能的多静态 ISAC，适用于 5G 及更高版本
items.summary_zh: 使用 5G 及其他机会信号的集成传感和通信 (ISAC) 系统可使用共享基础设施和频谱资源实现联合无线传感和通信。虽然多基地 ISAC 可以通过空间分布的接收器增加传感覆盖范围，但密集和动态杂波会显着降低双基地范围和多普勒估计，导致目标定位和速度估计出现错误。本文提出了一种具有杂波抑制功能的多基地 ISAC 框架，用于目标位置和速度的高保真估计。分布式杂波通过具有不同多普勒扩展和雷达横截面的随机定位散射体进行建模，以捕获密集和动态的杂波效应。对各种传统信号处理基线进行了杂波抑制评估，结果显示在强杂波条件下鲁棒性有限。为了解决这一限制，引入了基于深度学习的杂波抑制方法，通过采用残差和注意力增强的深度神经网络架构来提高针对密集和动态杂波的鲁棒性，直接增强来自杂波污染观测的目标响应。这些方法在多基地 ISAC 中各种杂波条件下的目标位置和速度估计方面明显优于传统方法。

extra.description: Integrated sensing and communications (ISAC) systems using 5G and beyond signals of opportunity enable joint wireless sensing and communication using shared infrastructure and spectrum resources. While multistatic ISAC can increase sensing coverage with spatially distributed receivers, dense and dynamic clutter can significantly degrade bistatic range and Doppler estimation, leading to errors in target localization and velocity estimation. This paper presents a multistatic ISAC framework with clutter suppression for high-fidelity estimation of target position and velocity. Distributed clutter is modeled with randomly located scatterers with varying Doppler spreads and radar cross sections to capture dense and dynamic clutter effects. A broad range of conventional signal processing baselines are evaluated for clutter suppression, showing limited robustness under strong clutter conditions. To address this limitation, deep learning-based clutter suppression methods are introduced to improve robustness against dense and dynamic clutter by employing residual and attention-enhanced deep neural network architectures that directly enhance target responses from clutter-contaminated observations. These methods substantially outperform conventional approaches in target position and velocity estimation across diverse clutter conditions in multistatic ISAC.
